definitions.explanation: A thin line of breakage on a hard surface such as glass, ceramic, bone, or a wall. The object is damaged but not fully broken apart.
A figurative crack in a relationship or bond between people. Describes a situation where trust or harmony is damaged, though the relationship has not completely ended.

notes:
USAGE:
ひび is most commonly used in the pattern ひび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (a crack forms). It describes damage that has not yet resulted in a full break — the object or relationship is weakened but still intact. Sometimes written in kanji as {罅|ひび}, but the kana form is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (a crack forms; to crack)
- ひび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ (a cracked plate)
- ひび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repair a crack)
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ひび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to get a hairline fracture)
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ひび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (a rift forms in a relationship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ひび: crack (thin line of damage, not fully broken)
- {割|わ}れ{目|め}: split, seam (a wider opening or gap)
- ⟦{亀裂|きれつ}→亀裂：09411_kiretsu⟧: crack, fissure (more formal; often used figuratively for organizations or alliances)
